evidence.title: Meet FreeToken: An Edge-Native MoE Serving Engine that Runs 753B GLM-5.2 on a Single Workstation GPU

summary: FreeToken unveiled an edge‑optimized mixture‑of‑experts (MoE) serving platform that can execute the massive 753‑billion‑parameter GLM‑5.2 model using only one workstation‑class GPU. The solution promises to bring state‑of‑the‑art large language model inference to low‑cost, on‑premise hardware for developers and enterprises.
title: FreeToken launches edge‑native MoE serving engine that runs 753B‑parameter GLM‑5.2 on a single workstation GPU
